title: PH60109: Crystal Physics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Elements of crystallography; symmetry-properties and relations; introduction to
crystal physics; effect of symmetry on electrical, dielectric, thermal and
optical properties of crystals; symmetry of higher rank tensors and their
applications to crystal properties; thermodynamics of crystals; magnetic
symmetry of crystal physics; some general problems of crystal physics.
